note: The entitlement server's RSA-2048 PUBLIC key. A public key is not a secret:
it can only CHECK a token, never make one, so it is committed on purpose and
a build is reproducible from this repository alone.
This is the real production key. The matching PRIVATE half was generated by
tools/make-entitlement-key.sh and lives only in the Cloudflare Worker secret
ENTITLEMENT_SIGNING_KEY; it is not in this repository and never will be.
A build whose public_key_pem still reads PLACEHOLDER fails closed -- no token
validates, every player is free, nothing unlocks -- and tools/verify.sh now
refuses such a tree so that state cannot reach a store.
To confirm the Worker holds the matching half, compare this fingerprint:
JSON rather than .pem because Godot exports .json as a resource; a bare .pem
would need an include_filter entry in every preset and would be missing from a
build the first time somebody added a preset and forgot.
